title: NovelAI text memory (novelai/text/memory.json)
description: Optional sibling of novelai/text/spec/. When present, text is always included in every novelai-text generation. Omit the file to skip. Combined as system_prompt, memory, matching lorebook entries, then spec input, joined by blank lines, and sent as the single /ai/generate input.

text.description: Persistent facts always included in context. Placed after system_prompt and before matching lorebook entries in the assembled /ai/generate input.
